description.text: The ninth Scarlet & Violet set, released on 28 March 2025 with 159 cards plus secret rares. It brought back Trainer's Pokémon, more than 40 of them, for four Trainers: N from Black and White, Iono from Scarlet and Violet, Lillie from Sun and Moon and Hop from Sword and Shield, with N's Zoroark ex, Iono's Bellibolt ex, Lillie's Clefairy ex and Hop's Zacian ex. It was the first set with the I regulation mark.
